From the archive · Detroit 2022

What makes learning inspiring?

Sharing the everyday teaching experiences that help design students grow.

Date
2 November 2022
Time
13:30–15:00 local time
Location
A. Alfred Taubman Center for Design Education, Room 1141
460 W Baltimore Ave, Detroit, MI 48202, United States
Format
Onsite & online · Cumulus members
Hosts
College for Creative Studies
OCAD University
University of the Arts London

Looking closely at everyday teaching

The workshop introduced the developing Cumulus Design Competency Resource. Educators shared classroom and studio experiences, then worked in small groups to identify the competencies students developed. Tagging these experiences would help other teachers discover and share them.

The initiative grew from a partnership begun at Cumulus Hong Kong in 2016 and developed through subsequent conferences. AADTE, Cumulus and Design Competency Futures collaborated on the resource with Cumulus grant support.

Workshop facilitators

Job Rutgers (OCAD University) and John Fass (London College of Communication), founders of Design Competency Futures, facilitated the session. The aim was to collect credited teaching experiences for the resource and continue the conversation at Cumulus Antwerp.
